title: Method report: an engine's offline method evaluation, bench episodes aggregated by situation (budget row) and proposer (Ingenium R3, SDK 0.5.0)
description: Measurement only, written by the engine (Ingenium bench --report methods; kept at observations/planning/method-report.json when saved next to a bundle). Per budget row and proposer: episodes, ticks, the share of the row's ticks, the mean predicted and realized progress, the mean absolute prediction error, the delivery rate (realized >= 70 % of a positive prediction), the clear rate of the runs and the decision wall clock (recorded, never used to decide). It is the evidence a budget table proposal cites and never changes a table. Counts and numbers only.

proposer_share.description: Share of all ticks by proposer.

rule_share.description: Share of replanning episodes by selector rule.

share.description: Share of the row's ticks this proposer's plans ran.
